selections.rationale: Creates reusable shared GTM context from product, market, proof, buyer, and sales-motion inputs.
Defines and tests an ICP using customer evidence, losses, counterexamples, and fit criteria.
Rebalances account assignments using workload, potential, continuity, capacity, and scenario analysis.
Produces an evidence-backed named-account brief from current public sources while separating facts from hypotheses.
Builds a long-term account strategy across units, relationships, footprint, opportunities, whitespace, and investment choices.
Turns an existing ICP and account list into tiers, contact coverage, priorities, and learning goals.
Creates responsible multichannel outreach grounded in approved evidence and proof points.
Prepares first-call hypotheses, questions, agenda, listening targets, and next-step standards.
Extracts transcript-grounded evidence, decisions, objections, commitments, next steps, and coaching observations.
Assesses qualification from available evidence, contradictions, and missing decision information.
Uses calls, observations, and outcomes to select an evidence-based behavior experiment and coaching cycle.
Creates an active-deal strategy covering stakeholders, competition, risks, proof, resources, and prioritized actions.
Diagnoses the trust concern and prepares honest response options, questions, and next steps.
Designs a tailored demonstration around buyer outcomes, workflow, proof needs, questions, and limitations.
Prepares packages, trades, concessions, approval paths, boundaries, and commercial negotiation sequencing.
Creates a buyer-editable shared plan with milestones, dependencies, acceptance status, and legitimate no-go outcomes.
Reviews CRM pipeline data for hygiene, deal risk, buyer momentum, concentration, and management priorities.
Builds an auditable quarterly forecast with downside, expected, and upside scenarios from pipeline and history.
Transfers signed scope, discovery, promises, risks, stakeholders, and implementation dependencies into a complete handoff.
Evaluates outcomes, adoption, support history, obligations, stakeholder evidence, risks, and renewal readiness.
Finds supportable patterns across wins, losses, no-decisions, reason codes, and buyer interviews and identifies learning tests.
Designs a testable referral and co-sell motion with economics, attribution, permission, stages, and stop rules.
First extracts buyer-grounded evidence from the transcript, then updates qualification without elevating seller claims.
First identifies pipeline defects, exclusions, and contradictions, then carries those findings into the forecast.
First creates a sourced account brief, then converts its still-unverified hypotheses into a first-call discovery plan.
